segments.he: בֶּן תֵּשַׁע שָׁנִים וְיוֹם אֶחָד — הוּא פּוֹסֵל עַל יְדֵי אַחִין, וְהָאַחִין פּוֹסְלִין עַל יָדוֹ. אֶלָּא הוּא פּוֹסֵל תְּחִלָּה, וְהָאַחִין פּוֹסְלִין תְּחִלָּה וָסוֹף.
segments.en: § The mishna addresses a different issue: If a boy «aged nine years and one day» had relations with his yevama «he» thereby «disqualifies» his «brothers» from levirate marriage, despite the fact that as a minor he has not acquired the yevama through this act of intercourse, «and the brothers» likewise «disqualify» the woman from «him» if they have intercourse with the yevama. «However,» there is a difference between them, as «he disqualifies» them only if he engaged in relations with her «first, and the brothers disqualify» him whether they had relations «first or last.»

segments.he: כֵּיצַד? בֶּן תֵּשַׁע שָׁנִים וְיוֹם אֶחָד שֶׁבָּא עַל יְבִמְתּוֹ — פָּסַל עַל יְדֵי אַחִין. בָּאוּ עָלֶיהָ אַחִין וְעָשׂוּ בָּהּ מַאֲמָר, נָתְנוּ גֵּט אוֹ חָלְצוּ — פּוֹסְלִין עַל יָדוֹ.
segments.en: The mishna explains: «How so?» A boy «aged nine years and one day who had relations with his yevama has disqualified his brothers,» as they are no longer eligible to marry her. If his «brothers had relations with her,» or «performed levirate betrothal with her,» or «gave» her «a bill of divorce, or performed ḥalitza with her, they» permanently «disqualify him» from engaging in relations with her.

moves.cueHe: בן תשע שנים ויום אחד — הוא פוסל על ידי אחין
moves.summary: mutual disqualification, he first only, they first and last
illustrates: his relations disqualify them; their relations, betrothal, get or ḥalitza disqualify him

positions.claim: the nine-year-old disqualifies the brothers only when first; the brothers disqualify him first or last
